A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study, Language Model Circuits Are Sparse in the Neuron Basis. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–H are readable and can be matched despite repagination.

before.justification: v1 reports original circuit evaluations, RelP benchmark results, neuron-steering experiments, and appendix analyses of arithmetic, multilingual antonyms, and user modelling.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The MLP activation basis, RelP replacement rules and half-rule, node and edge attribution, circuit selection, and steering procedures remain unchanged. The added ADAG reference describes follow-up work without modifying this paper's method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same four SVA subtasks, MIB tasks, state-capital questions, addition problems, nine-language antonym dataset, and synthetic user-modelling task. No evaluated task or population is added or removed.

E2.justification: The neuron/SAE and IG/RelP comparisons retain their comparator sets. Table 3 preserves Random, EAP and NAP variants, and IFR; Figure 5 retains IG-inp. and both RelP edge-attribution variants.

E3.justification: Section 6.1 changes the reported steering-selection specification from the discrete set {-4, -2, -1, 0, 2, 4} to choosing one multiplier in [-4, 4]. This is a limited, less specific protocol description; unchanged Figure 6 does not establish that experiments were rerun. Other evaluation settings are retained.

E4.justification: The stop-gradient comparison, zero-ablation check, attribution-distribution analyses, neuron-description analyses, and appendix case studies remain unchanged. The arithmetic mod-n robustness check is already present in v1.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains averaging over three runs with different random seeds. Neither version adds or changes uncertainty estimates, significance tests, or other statistical reporting procedures.

E6.justification: The plotted results and numerical tables match, including RelP's average CMD of 0.08 in Table 3, the Texas steering outcomes in Figure 6, and the appendix feature scores and AUROCs. Apparent shifts in table entries result from repagination.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, IG/conductance derivations, and RelP half-rule completeness proof are retained. Removing an extra closing parenthesis in Equation (8) is a typographical correction.

C1.justification: The central claims remain that MLP-neuron circuits can match SAE sparsity and faithfulness and support interpretable steering without additional training. The abstract's revised description of finding causally effective neurons retains the same contribution scope.

C2.justification: v2 removes the introduction's explicit caveat about neurons being less interpretable than dictionary features, adds a hidden-state reasoning interpretation of the single-neuron result in Section 6.2, and points to ADAG as addressing the limitations discussed in Section 7. No supporting experiment is added.

D1.justification: v2 newly provides the TransluceAI/circuits repository address below the abstract, adding explicit code-access information. Existing implementation descriptions, model choices, and most hyperparameter disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Arora et al. (2026), ADAG, as follow-up work addressing automation limitations. Section 7 also clarifies that the cited CLT work's neuron ablation used activation thresholding, refining the comparison with gradient-based neuron tracing.

P1.justification: Localized edits revise the abstract, introduction, method exposition, and discussion; remove the 'Result 1–4' heading prefixes; and add acknowledgements and appendix contents. Most prose and organization remain intact. Section 6.2 introduces an unfinished 'rather than e' clause.

P2.justification: v2 adds an appendix contents page and repository icon, restyles prompt examples and the prompt-template listing, and reflows appendix tables. The scientific figures and table structures remain substantially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The new code-access address, linked appendix contents, and clearer prior-work comparison modestly improve reproducibility guidance and usability while preserving the scientific evidence. These gains outweigh the limited regressions from less precise steering-selection reporting and the unfinished sentence in Section 6.2.
